WITH T01 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT OPPOR.SALFCY_0 Site, OPPOR.OPPNUM_0 ProjectNO, OPPOR.OPPEXTNUM_0 PN, OPPOR.CREDAT_0 ProjectDate FROM EXPLOIT.OPPOR OPPOR WHERE 1=1
AND OPPOR.SALFCY_0 IN ('ZHU','HKG','YSH')
AND OPPOR.SALFCY_0 = #{Site}
-- CDE: Order project -- ART: Stock project AND OPPOR.OPPTYP_0 IN ('CDE','ART') AND (OPPOR.CREDAT_0 BETWEEN CONVERT(DATETIME, #{DateFrom} ,120) AND CONVERT(DATETIME, #{DateTo} ,120)) ), T02 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT OPPOR.SALFCY_0 Site, OPPOR.ZOPPNUMORI_0 ProjectNO, OPPOR.OPPEXTNUM_0 PN, OPPOR.CREDAT_0 ProjectDate FROM EXPLOIT.OPPOR OPPOR WHERE 1=1
AND OPPOR.SALFCY_0 IN ('ZHU','HKG','YSH')
AND OPPOR.SALFCY_0 = #{Site}
AND OPPOR.ZOPPNUMORI_0 != '' -- CDE: Order project -- ART: Stock project AND OPPOR.OPPTYP_0 IN ('CDE','ART') AND (OPPOR.CREDAT_0 BETWEEN CONVERT(DATETIME, #{DateFrom} ,120) AND CONVERT(DATETIME, #{DateTo} ,120)) ), T03 AS ( SELECT * FROM T01
UNION SELECT * FROM T02 ), T1 AS ( ---- Project sales line price include tax SELECT DISTINCT SORDERQ.SALFCY_0 AS Site, IIF(SORDERQ.YSOQ_PJTORI_0 = '', SORDERQ.YSOH_PJT_0, SORDERQ.YSOQ_PJTORI_0) AS ProjectNO, SORDERQ.SOHNUM_0 AS OrderNO, SORDERQ.SOPLIN_0 AS OrderLine, SORDERP.ITMREF_0 AS PN, SORDERQ.QTY_0 AS QTY, SORDERP.NETPRIATI_0, SORDER.CUR_0 AS Currency, SORDERP.NETPRIATI_0 * SORDERQ.QTY_0 AS ProjectSalesPrice, SORDERP.NETPRIATI_0 * SORDERQ.QTY_0 * ( SORDER.ORDINVATIL_0 / SORDER.ORDINVATI_0) AS ProjectSalesLocalPrice FROM T03 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDERQ SORDERQ ON T03.Site = SORDERQ.SALFCY_0 AND (T03.ProjectNO = SORDERQ.YSOH_PJT_0 OR T03.ProjectNO = SORDERQ.YSOQ_PJTORI_0) INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDERP SORDERP ON SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 = SORDERQ.SOHNUM_0 AND SORDERP.SOPLIN_0 = SORDERQ.SOPLIN_0 AND SORDERQ.SALFCY_0 = #{Site} AND SORDERP.SALFCY_0 = #{Site} AND SORDERP.NETPRIATI_0 > 0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDER SORDER ON SORDERQ.SOHNUM_0 = SORDER.SOHNUM_0 ), T2 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT PORDERP.PRHFCY_0 AS Site, PORDERP.PJT_0 AS ProjectNO, PORDERQ.CPRCUR_0 AS LocalCurrency, Sum(PORDERQ.LINAMTCPR_0 + PORDERQ.AMTTAXLIN1_0 + PORDERQ.AMTTAXLIN2_0 + PORDERQ.AMTTAXLIN3_0) OVER (PARTITION BY PORDERP.PJT_0) AS ProjectLocalCost FROM T03 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDERP AS PORDERP ON T03.ProjectNO = PORDERP.PJT_0 AND T03.Site = PORDERP.PRHFCY_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDERQ AS PORDERQ ON PORDERP.POHNUM_0 = PORDERQ.POHNUM_0 AND PORDERP.POPLIN_0 = PORDERQ.POPLIN_0 WHERE 1=1 AND PORDERQ.PRHFCY_0 = #{Site} AND PORDERP.PRHFCY_0 = #{Site} )
SELECT T03.Site, T03.ProjectNO, T03.PN, RTRIM(ITMMASTER.ITMDES1_0 +' '+ ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0 +' '+ ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0) AS Description, ITMMASTER.TSICOD_1 AS ProductFamily, T03.ProjectDate, T1.OrderNO, T1.OrderLine, T1.QTY, T1.Currency, T1.ProjectSalesPrice, T1.ProjectSalesLocalPrice, T2.LocalCurrency, T2.ProjectLocalCost, T1.ProjectSalesLocalPrice - T2.ProjectLocalCost AS Profit, T1.ProjectSalesLocalPrice / T2.ProjectLocalCost AS ProfitRate FROM T03 LEFT JOIN EXPLOIT.ITMMASTER ITMMASTER ON T03.PN = ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 INNER JOIN T1 ON T1.ProjectNO = T03.ProjectNO AND T1.Site = T03.Site LEFT JOIN T2 ON T2.ProjectNO = T03.ProjectNO AND T2.Site = T03.Site ORDER BY T03.ProjectDate ASC
